column1: DENGUE CASE REPORTING During  the  29th  week,  7385  suspected  dengue  cases were reported across all 26 districts, compared to 7619 cases in the previous week, reflecting an 3.1% decrease. The  Western  Province  accounted  for  52.4%  of  total cases,  with the  Colombo  Municipal  Council (CMC) contributing 3.6%, the rest of Colombo District 17.1%, Gampaha  District  24.6%,  and  Kalutara  District  7.1%. Outside the Western Province, notable case contributions were reported from Kandy (8.9%), Matara (6.1%),  Ratnapura  (4.7%),  Galle  (4.4%),  Kurunegala (3.5%), Puttalam (3.1%) Kegalle (3%), and Hambantota (2.4%) (see Table 1) (compared to the previous week, colour of %: red=increase, green=decrease, blue=no change).
